summary: Explains how Datasmith translates Graphisoft Archicad scenes (via Direct Link or .udatasmith export) into Unreal: layers as Actors, HotLinks, PBR materials with _DS two-sided suffix, light type mapping, cameras, IFC/classification metadata and Actor Tags.
gotchas: Pivot points may be wrong due to Archicad SDK limitations
Parallel lights, Sun Object and Window Light are not supported
Area lights import as point lights; shadow opacity/quality not supported
Undefined metadata is not exported

summary: Describes importing Maxon Cinema 4D .c4d files directly with the Datasmith C4D Importer plugin: how geometry, generators/cloners, lights, cameras, layers, C4DMaster-based material instances, animations (to Level Sequences) and User Data metadata are translated.
gotchas: Procedural textures, node-based materials (R20+) and third-party renderers are not supported; bake to bitmaps
Only one Reflectance layer is translated
Hidden objects are not imported; generators/deformers baked to single meshes
User Data groups are flattened and all values become strings

summary: Covers bringing 3DExcite Deltagen and Autodesk VRED scenes into Unreal as .fbx via the Datasmith FBX Importer, including conversion of variant sets into a LevelVariantSets asset for the Variant Manager and animations into Level Sequences.
gotchas: Only VRED Professional is supported, not VRED Design
Deltagen look variants are not supported
Variant switching UI must be built yourself

summary: Explains the Datasmith Exporter for Navisworks workflow: installing the exporter, merging hierarchy at a user-defined depth to keep meshes under 1M triangles, choosing a scene origin, Tab-prefixed metadata, and master/instance materials.
gotchas: Navisworks double-precision coordinates need a user-set origin to avoid imprecision
Merged meshes capped at 1M triangles
Uninstall previous exporter versions and close Navisworks before installing

summary: Details how the Datasmith Exporter for Revit translates a 3D View into Unreal: visibility/section box control, per-element Static Meshes and instancing, tessellation level, RevitMaster materials, Level/host hierarchy, CineCameraActor, category Layers, metadata filtering, RPC objects and survey/base points.
gotchas: A 3D View must be active to export; Graphic Display Options and rendering settings are ignored
Parametric constraints are not carried over
Procedural textures (Checker, Noise, Tiles) are not converted
Orthographic and shifted/cropped camera perspectives are not supported

summary: Describes Datasmith export and Direct Link from McNeel Rhino: toolbar commands, NURBS tessellation via Rhino mesh settings, block instancing, preserved mesh modifiers, materials, Named Views as CineCameraActors, Attribute User Text metadata and layer-based Actor hierarchy.
gotchas: Rhino display colors are ignored; only materials import
Rhino Groups do not affect hierarchy
Manually dragged toolbar copies are not removed on uninstall

summary: Explains the Datasmith Exporter for SketchUp Pro: Ruby batch export, Direct Link, how faces in components/groups become Static Meshes, instancing, billboards, single-sided geometry handling, editable parent materials (Color, Texture, Opacity, UE Extended), and component metadata.
gotchas: Only SketchUp Pro is supported, not SketchUp Free or Make
Direct Link only with SketchUp 2020/2021 on UE 4.27+
Back faces of single-sided geometry are culled and do not cast shadows
Material edits are overwritten on reimport

summary: Covers installing the Solidworks Exporter plugin, saving as .udatasmith or using Direct Link, and how Solidworks parts, assemblies, configurations/display states (to Level Variant Sets), appearances and UVs convert into Unreal.
gotchas: Animations, lights, cameras and construction geometry are not supported
Open assemblies fully resolved for best data transfer
Per-instance materials can produce multiple static meshes because UVs are baked per material
Custom metadata is not carried over

summary: Shows how to re-tessellate individual Datasmith-imported CAD Static Meshes with new quality settings via Datasmith > Retessellate, without reopening the source CAD file, and the Retessellation Rule options.
gotchas: Retessellate is unavailable for assets imported as triangle meshes rather than parametric surfaces
Only tessellation settings can be changed; use Reimport for other settings

summary: Lists FBX importer error and warning messages with their causes and fixes, grouped by generic, mesh, Static Mesh, Skeletal Mesh and animation (bind pose, root bone, smoothing groups, material limits, LOD bones, track length).
gotchas: Static Meshes support up to 64 materials
Max bone count is 65536 and bone names must be unique
Skeletal Mesh needs at least one vertex weighted and a single root
Animation must contain the root bone track and match the skeleton

summary: Explains File > Import Into Level for importing a whole FBX scene as level Actors, one Actor's components, or a Blueprint, with per-asset options, named option overrides, and selective full-scene reimport.
gotchas: Only the Blueprint Asset hierarchy type supports full scene reimport
Unchecking an asset in the Scene tab does not stop it being imported
The importer never overwrites existing materials
Cameras import without animation; materials have basic support only

summary: Guide to preparing and importing Static Meshes via FBX: pivot, triangulation, UVs, materials, custom collision naming (UBX/UCP/USP/UCX), SOCKET_ helpers, vertex colors, Combine Meshes and importing LODs.
gotchas: Uses FBX 2020.2; other versions may be incompatible
With multiple meshes in one file only the first mesh's custom collision imports
Only Color and Normal maps auto-connect; specular imports unconnected
Sockets only work with a single mesh per FBX; sphere/box collision fails with non-uniform scale

summary: Reference of Geometry Scripting Blueprint/Python functions grouped by category: asset/component read-write, primitive generation, deformation, booleans and modeling, selections, normals, repair, UVs, collision, baking, bone weights, polygons, BVH queries and mesh pools, noting editor-only nodes.
keys: Create New Static Mesh Asset From Mesh
Set Static Mesh Collision From Mesh
Auto Generate X Atlas Mesh UVs
gotchas: Beta feature; use caution when shipping
Some nodes are editor-only (e.g. Create New Static Mesh Asset From Mesh, Catmull Clark SubD)
Low-level per-triangle loops are slow in Blueprint or Python
Vertex/Triangle ID gaps can appear; use Compact Mesh
new_in_59: Mesh Sculpt Layers functions are marked New.

summary: Describes how Lyra built parametric level-design Blueprint 'Tools' on GeneratedDynamicMeshActor with Geometry Scripting, baked them to Static Mesh assets, and swapped between tool and baked mesh with Actor Action Utilities and a cold-storage actor.
gotchas: Dynamic Mesh Component does not support Lumen, Nanite or instancing; bake to Static Mesh
Generated Dynamic Mesh Actor is editor-only and not included in cooked builds (UE 5.0)
Re-running Generate New Static Mesh creates a new Source Key and breaks links
A GeneratedMeshColdStorage actor must be in the level for swapping

summary: Summarises which groom features (strands, cards/meshes, rigid vs skinned binding, RBF, simulation, strand/guide caches) run on which platforms, plus known limitations.
gotchas: Strands rendering only on Windows DX11/DX12/Vulkan, macOS SM6 M2+, Linux, current-gen consoles
Skinned binding and RBF not on Switch or mobile
Grooms do not support Static or Stationary precomputed lighting
Path Tracer appearance differs from rasterizer; DoF may artifact

summary: Explains groom debug view modes (Lit > Groom: Instances, Guides, Memory, Voxels), dumping groom memory, and console variables for fixing voxel shadow artifacts and motion-vector artifacts on hair strands.
gotchas: Raising voxel page count can quickly increase memory
Many grooms or a close camera can run out of voxel pages

summary: Shows how to enable Niagara-based groom hair simulation in the Groom Asset Editor Physics panel and documents solver, external force, bend/stretch/collision constraint and strand parameters, plus Groom component overrides.
gotchas: Component simulation overrides require Enable Simulation on the groom asset first
Solver runs at 24 frames per second with sub steps

summary: Explains creating Follicle mask textures and Strands textures (depth, coverage, tangent, attributes, material) from a Groom asset's context menu, for skin blending and hair card/helmet LOD meshes.
gotchas: Resolution is rounded to a power of two
Textures are saved next to the source groom

summary: Tour of the Groom Asset Editor: viewport options, Show visualizations (guides, UVs, seeds, clusters, groups), LOD preview, and the Details panels for LOD, Interpolation, Strands, Cards, Meshes, Materials and Physics.
gotchas: Base Color and Roughness views show black if not exported with the groom

summary: Introduces the groom system parts — Groom asset (from Alembic .abc), Groom Binding asset (links to a Skeletal Mesh) and Groom Component — and lists Groom Component override properties (width, LOD bias, cards, binding, groom cache, physics asset).
gotchas: Groom system does not provide hair shaping; author in Maya XGen, Houdini etc.
Without a Binding Asset projection runs at runtime with a large GPU startup cost

summary: Describes groom Interpolation panel settings controlling how strands follow guides under skinning and simulation: decimation, guide type, interpolation quality/distance, RBF global interpolation and per-LOD RBF override.
gotchas: Global (RBF) interpolation only works when bound to a skeletal mesh with skinning
Medium/High interpolation quality can take dozens of minutes to build

summary: Explains assigning material slots to grooms, the requirement for the Hair shading model and Use with Hair Strands usage flag, and the Hair Attributes material expression outputs.
gotchas: Groom materials must use the Hair shading model
Depth, Coverage, AuxiliaryData, AtlasUVs outputs only apply to cards and mesh geometry

summary: Explains the hair strands rendering pipeline stages and console variables to trade quality for performance in interpolation, voxel shadowing, rasterization samples, sky lighting/AO and ray tracing, and fallback to cards/meshes.
gotchas: Strands are not supported on all platforms; use cards/meshes as fallback
Per-Pixel Linked List rasterization is very expensive, for cinematics only
Hair ray tracing geometry is off by default and costly when animated

summary: Documents the Groom Asset Editor Strands panel: per-group statistics and settings for material, hair width, root/tip scale, shadow density, ray tracing geometry, voxelization, stable rasterization and scatter scene lighting.
gotchas: Hair Raytracing Radius Scale only applies with Hardware Ray Tracing
Stable Rasterization should only be used on small scattered hair
